title: Comments restate the code line for line
description: 15 of 25 lines are comments that restate adjacent code exactly: '// Initialize the total to zero' above 'let total = 0;', '// Loop over each item in the cart' above 'for (const item of items)', etc. JSDoc also narrates the same loop. Readers must read the algorithm three times. Fix: drop inline comments and simplify doc comment to one line: '/** Sum of the prices of items. */'
